raw_record.original_question:
下图表示1960年位于我国某大城市市郊的一个镇多年来三大产业男女从业人员比例变化。读图回答：该镇女性从事第三产业人数超过第一产业的时间，与男性相比有什么先后关系？

<image1>
raw_record.answer: The time when the number of women engaged in the tertiary industry exceeded that in the primary industry was earlier than for men
raw_record.final_cot:

Compare the lengths of the bar segments for the primary industry and the tertiary industry according to the legend: in the female right-side panel, the year position where the tertiary-industry segment first becomes longer than the primary-industry segment appears before the corresponding change in the male left-side panel.
Reasoning: the question asks the order of precedence, compared with men, of the time when the number of women engaged in the tertiary industry exceeded that in the primary industry. From comparison of the positions of the first exceedance in the figure, it can be known that the time when the number of women in the tertiary industry exceeded that in the primary industry was earlier, while men had this change only later.
